% Statistical test results — auto-generated
% Wilcoxon signed-rank test + Cliff's delta
% N = 32 paired comparisons across datasets

A Wilcoxon signed-rank test on 32 paired category-level comparisons
(uniform vs.\ CLS-gated) yields a two-sided $p < 0.001$,
confirming that CLS-gating produces a statistically significant improvement.
The one-sided test (CLS $>$ uniform) gives $p < 0.001$.
CLS-gating improves 26 of 32 categories
(mean $\Delta = +2.8$~pp),
with a Cliff's delta of $0.62$ (large effect).
